t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the gnomes always appear in pairs orange & brown, green and pink, red and yellow, blue and purple. one set leads to the bright forest and the other leads to the dark forest. only their colours matter. try to go to the forest with the most mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: firstly, the orange, green, red and blue gnome would always lead you to a light forest with red basket and the brown, pink, yellow and purple would lead to the dark with yellow basket.the gnomes always appear in specific pairs (orange & brown, green & pink, red & yellow, Blue & purple)the mushroom in each forest changes constantly so try to build a sequence.you only need to watch out for the colours of the gnomes and nothing else(shape of hat and so on).
